debit.notes: 24-hour toll-free helpline 1800 1800, 1800 2021 (IVRS module integrated) or paid helpline 0120-2490000; global users: +91 120 2490000. Customer Care Division email care@pnb.bank.in (contact-us lists 'Hot-listing of lost and damaged debit/ATM card' among its requirements). SMS 'HOT [space] card number' to 5607040 from registered mobile. Internet banking: log in at https://ibanking.pnb.bank.in/, click Value added Service then select ATM/Debit Card Hotlisting. PNB One app: post-login, click the Debit Card button, then Hotlist Debit Card. WhatsApp banking: send 'Hi' to 92640-92640, choose All Services, Debit Card Services, Disable/Block Debit Card (temporary block or permanent block/Hotlist). Any PNB branch can also hotlist the card. Debit card once hotlisted cannot be de-hotlisted; complaints lodged at the Customer Relationship Centre get a docket number.

credit.notes: 24-hour credit-card customer helpline 1800 180 2345 or 0120-4616200 (global users: +91 120 4616200); call and email creditcardpnb@pnb.bank.in on loss, theft, fraudulent transaction or suspected compromise of card details to get the card hot-listed. No SMS block format, netbanking block path or app-based block for credit cards is published on the bank's pages.

upi.notes: UPI FAQ ('I have faced unauthorized debit through UPI'): 'In case of unauthorized debit through PNB account linked on any UPI enabled app, please block UPI through following channels: Branch, Call centre, Forwarding debit SMS to 92640 92640, Internet Banking, PNB one.' PNB One feature list publishes 'UPI Blocking' under UPI Services; the UPI module is reached by 'Click UPI icon under Pay & Transfer module' (bank FAQ). Lost phone: 'Open Internet banking URL - https://ibanking.pnb.bank.in Choose Retail Internet Banking Enter User ID Disable Mobile/Internet Banking' (freezes mobile/internet banking; UPI itself uses the block channels above); or call '1800 1800, 1800 2021, 0120-2490000'; or SMS 'BLOCK MBS CUSTID' to 9264092640; or WhatsApp 9264092640 emergency menu. *99# (NPCI USSD) is a published PNB UPI platform but only for payments/UPI PIN setup, not blocking. Bank's own UPI app: 'PNB UPI App has now been renamed to BHIM PNB' (Play link on bank's UPI page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fss.pnbpsp). Digital-products care line: 1800-330-3333. No iOS store URL published on fetched pages.
